messages:
sam: heads-up: sample app returns "500 internal error" for missing auth and rate limits. new users confused.

maria: that's bad. can you share an example resp?

sam: 
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json

{ "error": "internal error" }

jess: short-term: normalize into typed errors (AuthError/RateLimitError/TransientServerError) and add error.code enum. show retry-after in RateLimitError.

alejandro: long-term: runtime should have an edge mapping layer. current proxies return inconsistent codes and stacks.

maria: action items: sample-app PR to map and README blurb; runtime ticket to canonicalize; infra to strip stacks and add support_id header.

deploy-bot: build: sample-app `fix/error-shape` staged ✅

sam: please make this part of next SDK minor so SDKs expose typed exceptions by default.
